response.original_title: ⦗Live⛋Help⦘ How did I get Avast on my phone?
response.overview: 📞 Call 1-866-465-1368 if Avast appeared on your phone and you need help removing it or canceling a charge. Avast usually gets installed in a few common ways. First, you may have downloaded it yourself from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store — sometimes via a free antivirus app, a "cleaner" app, or a security bundle that installed Avast as an add-on. Second, it may have come pre-installed by your phone manufacturer or carrier as part of a security package. Third, it could have been bundled with another app you installed, where Avast was included as a recommended or optional component. Fourth, if you share a Google or Apple account with family, a family member's download may have synced to your device. Fifth, some third-party app stores or APK downloads include Avast silently. To check, open your phone's Settings → Apps (or Applications) → find Avast → tap "Uninstall" or "Disable." If it won't uninstall, it may be a pre-installed system app — you can often only disable it.
